description: This file defines data classes related to chat messaging, including message contents, session entries, pending tool calls, chat history, and outgoing attachments. It appears to serve as a model or data structure module within a chat application.

classes.name: ChatMessage
classes.description: Represents a chat message with an identifier, role, content list, and optional timestamp.

classes.name: ChatMessageContent
classes.description: Contains the content details of a message, including type, text, mime type, filename, and base64 encoded data.

classes.name: ChatPendingToolCall
classes.description: Represents a pending tool call in the chat, including its ID, name, arguments, start time, and error status.

classes.name: ChatSessionEntry
classes.description: Represents a chat session entry with a key, last updated timestamp, and optional display name.

classes.name: ChatHistory
classes.description: Contains the entire message history for a chat session, along with session identifiers and a thinking level.

classes.name: OutgoingAttachment
classes.description: Details an outgoing attachment with type, MIME type, filename, and base64 content.
